mainTopic: The order of levirate acts (מאמר, גט, ביאה, חליצה) with two יבמות, and the גמרא's reasons for which acts still count afterward.
overview: The משנה applies its rules for levirate acts done one after another to a יבם with two יבמות. It goes through cases that start with a מאמר and cases that start with a גט, and rules which ones need a גט and which still need חליצה. Then it gives the big rule: nothing counts after חליצה, wherever it comes in the series. A ביאה ends everything only when it is the first act, but רבי נחמיה says ביאה ends everything wherever it comes, just like חליצה. The גמרא first points out that everyone agrees a single גט or a single מאמר works on a יבמה. It explains that the רבנן gave them force so people would not think חליצה or ביאה is also ineffective. Next it explains that a flawed ביאה leaves room for later acts because of decrees against confusing it with forbidden cases. A flawed חליצה, though, needs no such decree, since any mix-up would cause no harm. The amud ends as רבא begins a new statement.

steps.title: The rules apply to one widow and to two widows
steps.stepSummary: The משנה says its rules for levirate acts done one after another apply both to one יבמה and to two יבמות with one יבם. Then it asks 'how so?' to begin the examples.
steps.simpleTranslation: These rules are the same whether there is one יבמה with one יבם, or two יבמות with one יבם. How does this work?
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה widens its rules to include a case of two widows with one brother-in-law. It asks 'how so?' to set up the list of examples that comes next.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Before this, the משנה dealt with one יבם doing several acts with one יבמה. Now it says the same logic holds when he does one act with one widow and another act with her צרה, her co-wife. The 'כיצד' is only a setup line. The actual rulings come in the next steps.

keyTerms.meaning: The widow of a man who died without children, who is bound to his brother
The brother of the dead husband, who must do יבום or חליצה
How so? (introduces examples)

phrases.english: Both one yevama to one yavam,
and two yevamot to one yavam.
How so?

steps.triggerLanguage: אֶחָד יְבָמָה אַחַת לְיָבָם אֶחָד, וְאֶחָד שְׁתֵּי יְבָמוֹת לְיָבָם אֶחָד
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Opens this section by extending the earlier rules of the משנה to two יבמות.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The rules about acts done one after another apply equally to one יבמה and to two יבמות with one יבם.

steps.title: Cases that start with a levirate betrothal
steps.stepSummary: The יבם does a מאמר with one widow and then a second act with the other: another מאמר, a גט, a ביאה, or חליצה. The משנה rules what each case needs.
steps.simpleTranslation: If he did a מאמר with this one and a מאמר with that one, they need two גיטין and חליצה. If he did a מאמר with this one and gave a גט to that one, she needs a גט and there must be חליצה. If he did a מאמר with this one and had relations with that one, they need two גיטין and חליצה. If he did a מאמר with this one and חליצה with that one, the first one needs a גט.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה goes through four cases where the first act is a מאמר with one widow and the second act is done with the other widow.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A מאמר makes a rabbinic tie, so the woman it was done with needs a גט to undo it. As long as the יבום is not fully finished, חליצה is still needed to free them from the levirate bond. In the last case the חליצה with the second widow already frees both of them from the bond, so only the גט for the first woman's מאמר is left.

keyTerms.meaning: A rabbinic levirate betrothal, done with money or a document
A bill of divorce
The ceremony that frees the widow from the levirate bond
He had relations with her (ביאה)

steps.confusionAlert: In the ביאה case you might think the ביאה finishes the יבום. Here it does not, because a מאמר was already done with her co-wife. That is why חליצה is still needed and both women need a גט.

phrases.english: If he did levirate betrothal with this one and levirate betrothal with that one —
they need two bills of divorce and חליצה.
phrases.notes: Each woman needs her own גט for her own מאמר. חליצה with one of them frees both.

phrases.english: Levirate betrothal with this one and a bill of divorce to that one —
she needs a bill of divorce, and there must be חליצה.
phrases.notes: 'She' is the first woman, the one who had the מאמר.

phrases.english: Levirate betrothal with this one and he had relations with that one —
they need two bills of divorce and חליצה.
Levirate betrothal with this one and he did חליצה with that one —
the first one needs a bill of divorce.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Gives the first group of examples promised by the 'כיצד'.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: A מאמר always needs a גט to undo it. חליצה is needed unless it has already been done, and חליצה with one widow frees both from the levirate bond.

steps.title: Cases that start with a bill of divorce
steps.stepSummary: The יבם gives a גט to one widow and then does a second act with the other: another גט, a ביאה, a מאמר, or חליצה. The last case brings in the rule that nothing counts after חליצה.
steps.simpleTranslation: If he gave a גט to this one and a גט to that one, they need חליצה from him. If he gave a גט to this one and had relations with that one, she needs a גט and there must be חליצה. If he gave a גט to this one and did a מאמר with that one, she needs a גט and there must be חליצה. If he gave a גט to this one and did חליצה with that one, nothing counts after חליצה.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה goes through four cases where the first act is a גט to one widow and the second act is done with the other widow.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A levirate גט does not end the bond completely, so חליצה is still needed. A ביאה or מאמר with the second widow after a גט to the first does not fully work either, so she needs a גט and there must still be חליצה. Once חליצה is done, the bond is over, and nothing done afterward has any effect.

keyTerms.meaning: From him
Nothing counts after חליצה

phrases.english: A bill of divorce to this one and a bill of divorce to that one —
they need חליצה from him.
A bill of divorce to this one and he had relations with that one —
she needs a bill of divorce, and there must be חליצה.
phrases.notes: 'She' is the second woman, the one he had relations with.

phrases.english: A bill of divorce to this one and levirate betrothal with that one —
she needs a bill of divorce, and there must be חליצה.
A bill of divorce to this one and he did חליצה with that one —
nothing counts after חליצה.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Same pattern as step 2, but now the first act is a גט instead of a מאמר.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: A גט does not end the need for חליצה. Once חליצה has been done, no later act takes effect.

steps.title: Nothing counts after חליצה or full ביאה
steps.stepSummary: The משנה lists cases where the first act is חליצה or ביאה, followed by any other act. It rules that nothing after that first act counts, whether with one יבם and two יבמות or two יבמין and one יבמה.
steps.simpleTranslation: If he did חליצה and then חליצה, or חליצה and then a מאמר, a גט, or ביאה; or ביאה and then ביאה, or ביאה and then a מאמר, a גט, or חליצה, nothing counts afterward. This is true for one יבם with two יבמות, and for two יבמין with one יבמה.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה states a general rule. When the first act is חליצה or a full ביאה, whatever comes after it has no effect.
steps.deeperAnalysis: חליצה ends the levirate bond, and a ביאה finishes the יבום. Either way, the bond is gone, so a later מאמר, גט, ביאה or חליצה has nothing to act on. The משנה adds that this works the same with two brothers and one widow: once one brother has done חליצה or ביאה, the other brother's acts mean nothing.

keyTerms.meaning: He did חליצה
Brothers-in-law (more than one יבם)
Whether... or (this applies both ways)

steps.whyThisMatters: This sets the basic idea of the whole section: חליצה and full ביאה are final acts, unlike מאמר and גט, which leave things partly open.

phrases.english: He did חליצה and then חליצה,
or he did חליצה and then levirate betrothal,
gave a bill of divorce, or had relations,
phrases.notes: Read this as still following חליצה: חליצה and then a גט, or חליצה and then ביאה.

phrases.english: or he had relations and then had relations,
or he had relations and then did levirate betrothal,
gave a bill of divorce, or did חליצה —
nothing counts after חליצה.
Whether one yavam with two yevamot,
or two yevamin with one yevama.

steps.triggerLanguage: חָלַץ וְחָלַץ, אוֹ חָלַץ וְעָשָׂה מַאֲמָר
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Turns the closing line of step 3 into a general rule and applies it to more kinds of cases.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: After חליצה or a full ביאה, no later levirate act takes effect, whether with one יבם and two יבמות or two יבמין and one יבמה.

steps.title: No matter where the חליצה comes
steps.stepSummary: The משנה repeats the list and adds that the rule holds whether the חליצה came at the beginning, middle, or end of the series of acts.
steps.simpleTranslation: If he did חליצה and then a מאמר, a גט, or ביאה; or ביאה and then a מאמר, a גט, or חליצה, nothing counts after חליצה, whether it came at the beginning, in the middle, or at the end.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה closes the section by saying the 'nothing after חליצה' rule does not depend on where the חליצה falls in the order of acts.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Earlier the חליצה was always the first or last act. Now the משנה says that even if it came in the middle of a series, everything before it still counts, and everything after it does not. The key point is only what came after the חליצה.

keyTerms.meaning: At the beginning
In the middle
At the end

steps.whatToRemember: מאמר and גט are partial acts. They need a גט to undo them and still leave a need for חליצה. חליצה and full ביאה are final, so nothing done after them counts, no matter how many people are involved or where in the order they happen.

phrases.english: He did חליצה and then levirate betrothal,
gave a bill of divorce, or had relations,
or he had relations and then did levirate betrothal,
gave a bill of divorce, or did חליצה —
nothing counts after חליצה.
Whether at the beginning,
or in the middle,
or at the end.

steps.triggerLanguage: בֵּין בַּתְּחִלָּה, בֵּין בָּאֶמְצַע, בֵּין בַּסּוֹף
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Restates the list from step 4 and adds that the position of the חליצה makes no difference.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Wherever חליצה falls in a series of acts, everything after it is void.

steps.title: Where the ביאה comes in the series changes what it does
steps.stepSummary: The משנה rules that ביאה done as the first act ends everything after it. Done in the middle or at the end, later acts still have some effect.
steps.simpleTranslation: But ביאה: when it is the first act, nothing after it counts. When it is in the middle or at the end, something after it does count.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה adds a rule for ביאה (also called בעילה). It is not like חליצה, which ends everything wherever it comes.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Step 5 said that חליצה ends everything, whether it comes first, in the middle, or last. Here the משנה says ביאה is different. A first ביאה is a full act, so nothing after it counts. When an earlier act like a גט or מאמר came before it, the ביאה is weakened, so later acts still have some effect.

keyTerms.meaning: Intercourse; here, the ביאה of the יבם with the יבמה
At the beginning; the first act done
In the middle or at the end of a series of acts
Nothing after it counts

steps.confusionAlert: Do not mix up ביאה with חליצה here. In the opinion of the תנא קמא, חליצה ends everything wherever it comes. ביאה only ends everything when it is first.

phrases.english: But intercourse, when it is at the beginning:
nothing after it counts;
in the middle or at the end:
something after it does count.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Sets ביאה against חליצה. Step 5 said חליצה ends everything wherever it comes; ביאה works that way only when it is first.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: A first ביאה ends all later acts. A ביאה in the middle or at the end leaves room for later acts to count.

steps.title: רבי נחמיה: ביאה and חליצה end everything wherever they come
steps.stepSummary: רבי נחמיה disagrees. He holds that both ביאה and חליצה end everything after them, whether they come first, in the middle, or last.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי נחמיה says: both ביאה and חליצה, whether at the beginning, in the middle, or at the end, nothing after them counts.
steps.whatsHappening: רבי נחמיה argues with the previous ruling about ביאה. He treats ביאה exactly like חליצה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The תנא קמא said a ביאה in the middle or at the end is weaker. רבי נחמיה says no. For him, ביאה, like חליצה, is a strong act wherever it comes, so nothing after it counts.

keyTerms.meaning: Both this and that; the same rule for both

steps.whatToRemember: תנא קמא: חליצה ends everything wherever it comes; ביאה ends everything only when it is first. רבי נחמיה: both ביאה and חליצה end everything wherever they come.

phrases.english: Rabbi Neḥemya says:
both intercourse and ḥalitza,

phrases.aramaic: בֵּין בַּתְּחִלָּה בֵּין בָּאֶמְצַע בֵּין בַּסּוֹף —
phrases.english: whether at the beginning, in the middle, or at the end,
nothing after it counts.

steps.triggerLanguage: רַבִּי נְחֶמְיָה אוֹמֵר: אַחַת בְּעִילָה וְאַחַת חֲלִיצָה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Argues with step 6's ruling on ביאה in the middle or at the end.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: ביאה and חליצה both end all later acts, wherever they come in the series.

steps.title: Everyone agrees one גט or one מאמר works
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא notes that the argument in the משנה is only about a second גט or a second מאמר. A single גט or a single מאמר given to a יבמה works according to everyone.
steps.simpleTranslation: They only argue about a גט after a גט and a מאמר after a מאמר. But one גט to a יבמה, and one מאמר to a יבמה, works.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא begins by narrowing down what the argument in the משנה was about. This sets up the next question: why does a גט or מאמר work for a יבמה at all?
steps.deeperAnalysis: Earlier in the משנה, רבן גמליאל said a second גט or a second מאמר has no effect, and the חכמים said it does. The גמרא points out that even רבן גמליאל agrees the first one works. That is a surprise, since a יבמה is not yet his wife, and it leads to the question in the next step.

keyTerms.meaning: They only argue about this much and no further
A bill of divorce
Levirate betrothal: a kind of קידושין the יבם does with the יבמה
It works; it has an effect

phrases.english: GEMARA: They only disagree
phrases.notes: 'They' are רבן גמליאל and the חכמים, who argued earlier in the משנה.

phrases.english: about a bill of divorce after a bill of divorce
and levirate betrothal after levirate betrothal.
But one bill of divorce to a yevama
[and one levirate betrothal with a yevama] is effective.
phrases.notes: Some versions don't have the words in square brackets, but the point is the same: one מאמר also works.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Opens the גמרא by reading the משנה closely and drawing a point that everyone agrees on.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: A single גט or a single מאמר to a יבמה works according to everyone.

steps.title: Why does a גט work for a יבמה?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks why the רבנן said a גט has an effect on a יבמה.
steps.simpleTranslation: What is the reason the רבנן said a גט works for a יבמה?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא asks for the reason behind the rule that a גט works for a יבמה. This sets up the answer in the next step.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A גט normally ends a real marriage. A יבמה is only tied to the יבם and is not yet married to him, so it is unclear why a גט should do anything here. The words 'אמור רבנן' show this power was given by the רבנן.

keyTerms.meaning: What is the reason?
The רבנן said; the rule comes from the חכמים
The widow waiting for יבום or חליצה

phrases.english: What is the reason the Sages said
a bill of divorce is effective for a yevama?

steps.triggerLanguage: מַאי טַעְמָא אֲמוּר רַבָּנַן גֵּט בִּיבָמָה מַהֲנֵי
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Asks for the reason behind the גט half of step 8.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Why the רבנן gave a גט the power to affect a יבמה, even though she is not his wife.

steps.title: A גט works so people won't think חליצה doesn't work
steps.stepSummary: The רבנן made a גט work because a גט works in general. If it did nothing, people might think חליצה does nothing too, and the יבם might come to live with her after חליצה.
steps.simpleTranslation: Because it works in general. If you say it does not work, people will say: a גט sends her away and חליצה sends her away. Since a גט does not work, חליצה also does not work. Then he will come to live with her after חליצה.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers the question by showing what could go wrong if a גט had no effect.
steps.deeperAnalysis: People see a גט and חליצה as similar, since both end a connection to a woman. If a גט did nothing for a יבמה, they might reason that חליצה does nothing either. Then the יבם might live with her after חליצה, which is forbidden. So the רבנן made the גט work, to protect how people understand חליצה.

keyTerms.meaning: In general; in ordinary cases
To send her away; to end the connection
He will come to have relations with her

steps.whyThisMatters: This shows a common pattern: the רבנן sometimes give an act power so people will not draw a wrong conclusion about a related act.

phrases.english: Because it is effective in general.
phrases.notes: A גט normally works to divorce a married woman.

phrases.english: For if you say it is not effective, people will say:
A bill of divorce is to send her away, and ḥalitza is to send her away.
And since a bill of divorce is not effective,
ḥalitza is also not effective.
And he will come to have intercourse after ḥalitza.

steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: A גט works for a יבמה so that people will not conclude that חליצה also does nothing, which could lead to forbidden relations after חליצה.

steps.title: Why does a מאמר work for a יבמה?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא now asks the same question about a מאמר.
steps.simpleTranslation: And what is the reason the רבנן said a מאמר works for a יבמה?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא turns to the second half of step 8 and asks why a מאמר works. This sets up the next answer.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The question is built the same way as the question about the גט. The answer will also follow the same pattern, but with a different pair of acts.

keyTerms.meaning: And what is the reason?

phrases.english: And what is the reason the Sages said
levirate betrothal is effective for a yevama?

steps.triggerLanguage: וּמַאי טַעְמָא אֲמוּר רַבָּנַן מַאֲמָר בִּיבָמָה מַהֲנֵי
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Asks the same kind of question as step 9, now about a מאמר.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Why the רבנן gave a מאמר the power to affect a יבמה.

steps.title: A מאמר works so people won't think ביאה doesn't work
steps.stepSummary: The רבנן made a מאמר work because קידושין works in general. If it did nothing, people might think ביאה does nothing too, and he might go on to live with the other widow after the ביאה.
steps.simpleTranslation: Because it works in general. If you say it does not work, people will say: a מאמר is for acquiring and ביאה is for acquiring. Since a מאמר does not work, ביאה also does not work. Then he will come to have relations after ביאה.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא gives the reason, using the same pattern as the reason for the גט.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A מאמר and ביאה are both ways to acquire a woman. If a מאמר did nothing, people might think ביאה also does not fully acquire the יבמה. Then the יבם might also live with the other widow, which is forbidden once the first ביאה has been done. So the רבנן made the מאמר work.

keyTerms.meaning: To acquire; to make her his wife
Intercourse; the act that completes יבום

steps.whatToRemember: Both reasons follow one pattern. The רבנן gave the גט and the מאמר force so people would not wrongly think חליצה or ביאה, the acts that are similar to them, have no effect.

phrases.english: Because it is effective in general.
For if you say it is not effective, people will say:
Levirate betrothal is to acquire, and intercourse is to acquire.
And since levirate betrothal is not effective,
intercourse is also not effective.
And he will come to have intercourse after intercourse.
phrases.notes: He means with the other widow, after he already did ביאה with the first one.

steps.triggerLanguage: מִשּׁוּם דְּמַהֲנֵי בְּעָלְמָא. דְּאִי אָמְרַתְּ לָא מַהֲנֵי, אָמְרִי: מַאֲמָר לִקְנוֹת
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers step 11, following the same pattern as step 10.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: A מאמר works for a יבמה so that people will not conclude that ביאה also does nothing, which could lead to relations with the other widow after a ביאה.

steps.title: Why does a flawed ביאה leave room for more?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks why the רבנן hold that after a ביאה פסולה, more actions still have an effect.
steps.simpleTranslation: And what is the reason the רבנן said that after a flawed ביאה, something still has an effect?
steps.whatsHappening: After explaining גט and מאמר, the גמרא now asks about a ביאה פסולה. Why don't the רבנן let it close the case completely?
steps.deeperAnalysis: A ביאה פסולה is a ביאה that came after a step like a גט or a מאמר was already done. Normally ביאה completes יבום, so we would expect nothing to work after it. The גמרא wants the reason the רבנן say it does not finish things.

keyTerms.meaning: A flawed ביאה, done after a גט or מאמר was already given
Something after it still has an effect, so the process is not finished
And what is the reason?

phrases.english: And what is the reason the Rabbis said
that a flawed intercourse
phrases.notes: This means a ביאה that comes after a גט or מאמר was already given to one of the widows.

phrases.english: has something effective after it?

steps.triggerLanguage: וּמַאי טַעְמָא אֲמוּר רַבָּנַן בִּיאָה פְּסוּלָה יֵשׁ אַחֲרֶיהָ כְּלוּם
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Same 'why did the רבנן say this' pattern as steps 9 and 11, now applied to ביאה פסולה.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: The reason the רבנן hold that a ביאה פסולה does not end the process.

steps.title: Two decrees keep a flawed ביאה from finishing things
steps.stepSummary: The רבנן decreed that a ביאה after a גט is not fully effective because of ביאה after חליצה, and that a ביאה after a מאמר is not fully effective because of ביאה after ביאה.
steps.simpleTranslation: They say: if it is a ביאה after a גט, it is a decree, a ביאה after a גט because of a ביאה after חליצה. And if it is a ביאה after a מאמר, it is a decree, a ביאה after a מאמר because of a ביאה after ביאה.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers with two separate decrees, one for each kind of flawed ביאה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A ביאה after a גט looks a lot like a ביאה after חליצה, which is forbidden from the Torah. If the first one fully counted, people might think the second is fine too. In the same way, a ביאה after a מאמר could be confused with a ביאה with the second widow after a ביאה with the first, which is also forbidden.

keyTerms.meaning: A protective rule from the רבנן to stop people from making a mistake
Because of, here meaning out of concern for a similar case

steps.whyThisMatters: It shows that the רבנן's rulings here are not about the strength of the act. They are fences against confusing it with a real Torah prohibition.

phrases.aramaic: אָמְרִי: אִי בִּיאָה אַחַר הַגֵּט הִיא —
phrases.english: They say: If it is intercourse after a bill of divorce,
it is a decree about intercourse after a bill of divorce
because of intercourse after חליצה.
And if it is intercourse after a מאמר,
it is a decree about intercourse after a מאמר
because of intercourse after intercourse.
phrases.notes: He means a ביאה with the second widow after he already did a ביאה with the first one.

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמְרִי: אִי בִּיאָה אַחַר הַגֵּט הִיא
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: Both kinds of ביאה פסולה are not fully effective because of decrees, so they won't be confused with ביאה after חליצה or ביאה after ביאה.

steps.title: Why does a flawed חליצה end everything?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks why the רבנן hold that after a חליצה פסולה, nothing else has an effect.
steps.simpleTranslation: And what is the reason the רבנן said that after this flawed חליצה, nothing has an effect?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא turns to the opposite ruling. A flawed חליצה does close the case, so why is there no decree here?
steps.deeperAnalysis: For ביאה פסולה the רבנן made decrees so it would not finish things. The question is why they did not make a similar decree for חליצה פסולה. Instead they let it fully end the יבום bond.

keyTerms.meaning: A flawed חליצה, done after a גט or מאמר was already given
Nothing after it has any effect, so the process is finished

phrases.english: And what is the reason the Rabbis said
that this flawed חליצה
has nothing effective after it?

steps.triggerLanguage: וּמַאי טַעְמָא אֲמוּר רַבָּנַן הַאי חֲלִיצָה פְּסוּלָה אֵין אַחֲרֶיהָ כְּלוּם
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Uses the same question pattern, now for חליצה, which gets the opposite result.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Why no decree was made for חליצה פסולה, so that it fully ends the process.

steps.title: No reason to worry about חליצה after חליצה
steps.stepSummary: A decree for חליצה after a גט would only protect against חליצה after חליצה, and repeating חליצה causes no harm.
steps.simpleTranslation: They say: what is there to decree? Should we decree about חליצה after a גט because of חליצה after חליצה? In all cases like these, let her do חליצה and go.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers that there is nothing worth guarding against. It tries the first possible decree and shows it isn't needed.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The only case a חליצה after a גט could be confused with is a חליצה after a חליצה. An extra חליצה is not forbidden, so even if people mix them up, nothing bad happens. So no decree is needed.

keyTerms.meaning: What is there to decree? A rhetorical way of saying there is no need
Let her do חליצה and go on her way

phrases.english: They say: What is there to decree?
Should we decree about חליצה after a bill of divorce
because of חליצה after חליצה?
In all cases like these, let her do חליצה and go.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Starts answering step 15 by testing the first possible decree and rejecting it.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: A decree for חליצה after a גט is not needed, since repeating חליצה causes no harm.

steps.title: No reason to worry about חליצה after ביאה either
steps.stepSummary: A decree for חליצה after a מאמר is also not needed. In both cases a גט is still required, so no one will be misled.
steps.simpleTranslation: Should we decree about חליצה after a מאמר because of חליצה after ביאה? Is it so that חליצה after a מאמר does not need a גט for his מאמר? So too, חליצה after ביאה needs a גט for his ביאה.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא tries the second possible decree and rejects it too. This finishes the answer to step 15.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The worry would be that people see חליצה after a מאמר end things and think חליצה after ביאה needs nothing more. But a חליצה after a מאמר still needs a גט to undo the מאמר, just as a חליצה after ביאה needs a גט to undo the ביאה. Both cases look the same in practice, so there is nothing to confuse.

keyTerms.meaning: Is that to say...? It introduces a pushback
For his מאמר, to undo the bond the מאמר created
For his ביאה, to undo the marriage the ביאה created

steps.whatToRemember: ביאה פסולה does not end the process because the רבנן made decrees to prevent confusion with forbidden acts. חליצה פסולה does end it, because any confusion would either cause no harm or give the same result, a גט is needed anyway.
steps.confusionAlert: The proposal 'ליגזור' is not the conclusion. The גמרא raises it only to knock it down with 'אטו'.

phrases.english: Should we decree about חליצה after a מאמר
because of חליצה after intercourse?
Is that to say that חליצה after a מאמר
does not need a bill of divorce for his מאמר?
So too, חליצה after intercourse
needs a bill of divorce for his intercourse.

steps.triggerLanguage: לִיגְזוֹר חֲלִיצָה אַחַר מַאֲמָר מִשּׁוּם חֲלִיצָה אַחַר בִּיאָה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Second half of the answer begun in step 16, which tests and rejects the other possible decree.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: A decree for חליצה after a מאמר is not needed, because both that case and חליצה after ביאה require a גט, so no one would be misled.

steps.title: רבא begins a new statement
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא introduces a new teaching from רבא. His actual words follow right after this line.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא is setting up the next move by bringing in a new speaker, רבא. This line only tells us who is speaking, and the content of his teaching comes next.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Steps 13 to 17 explained the logic of the רבנן about what still works after a ביאה פסולה or a חליצה פסולה. Now the גמרא brings a fresh statement by an אמורא, רבא. The amud ends here, so his actual words come on the next amud.
steps.confusionAlert: Don't mix up רָבָא with רַבָּה. They are two different אמוראים, and the spellings look almost the same.

phrases.english: Rava said:

steps.alternativePossibleLabel: מסקנא (if רבא's coming statement is read as a final ruling on the topic)
steps.relationToPreviousStep: After the explanation of the רבנן's reasoning in steps 13 to 17, the גמרא brings in a new speaker, רבא, whose statement begins on the next amud.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: This line only names the speaker. רבא's actual teaching comes right after it.
